name: Scientific Agent Skills
summary: Collection of 177 SKILL.md research skills that teach AI agents scientific workflows, from genomics and drug discovery to data analysis.
description: 177 scientific and research skills for AI agents, covering biology, chemistry, medicine, physics, engineering, Earth science, data analysis and scientific communication. Skills wrap specific packages, databases and platforms — RDKit, Scanpy, BioPython, PubChem, ChEMBL, UniProt, Benchling, OMERO, Opentrons — with the conventions and validation checks needed to use them, plus scientific writing, peer review, posters, slides and regulatory documentation workflows. Installs via npx, the GitHub CLI skill command or as an Agent Plugins package; MIT licensed.
contains: 177 scientific and research skills as SKILL.md files following the Agent Skills standard
100+ scientific and financial databases; the Database Lookup skill documents 80 sources
70+ Python package skills (RDKit, Scanpy, scikit-learn …) and 9 lab-platform integrations (Benchling, OMERO …)
30+ analysis and communication tools: literature review, PPTX posters, slides, Mermaid diagrams, Paperclip citations
10+ research and clinical tools: hypothesis generation, grant writing, PK/PD modelling, ISO evidence preparation
installs via npx, GitHub CLI gh skill, or as an Agent Plugins package (plugin.json)
works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Google Antigravity and other Agent Skills hosts
48.4k GitHub stars; MIT licensed; described in arXiv:2609.00065
